name: Pinecone Starter
free_limit: Pinecone Starter: up to 2 GB vector storage, 2 million write units and 1 million read units/month, 1 GB egress/month and 5 indexes
watch_out: Starter is a recurring Free managed database allowance, limited to AWS us-east-1, one project and small teams, without an uptime SLA. Dedicated read nodes, backups and cross-region restore are unavailable; Builder ($20/month) and higher usage-based plans are distinct. Inference or Assistant resources can have separate limits.
